newsitem.title: USA: NYC sells $85 mln of tax-exempt bonds to retail.
newsitem.headline: NYC sells $85 mln of tax-exempt bonds to retail.

text.p: New York City on Friday said that during the first day of the retail presale order period it had sold approximately $85 million of the $550 million of tax-exempt bonds it is scheduled to sale on January 15.

The city also is selling $300 million of taxable issues to European investors as part of the same sale, and a New York City official noted that the early maturities, which domestic, retail investors typically prefer, were reserved for the overseas issue.
"Given the fact that we are not offering the first five years, it's pretty good," he said, commenting on the first day's results for retail presales. The official declined to be named.
The retail presale period ends on Tuesday, and the city said it hopes to get from $150 million to $250 million of orders for maturities beginning in 2003.
